tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnal 'byor 'dod rgu lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru ratna sambha wā ya/

bla ma rin 'byung gi rnal 'byor tshigs bcad du 'don par mos na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs mas skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed la/ yul gsal gdab pa ni/ chos nyid mi 'gyur bai ḍūrya'i sa gzhi'i dbus// dngos grub sna tshogs stsol ba'i rin chen khrir// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos 'dab stong rtser// shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin nyi zla'i steng*// yon tan ngo bo rin chen 'byung ldan dang*// dbyer med rje btsun bla ma dam pa ni// gser bzang 'bar ba'i mdog can brjid pa'i sku// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa mchog sbyin gyis// 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong zhing g.yon pa ni// mnyam gzhag phyag rgyas ting 'dzin rgyas par mdzad// thabs shes zung 'jug zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs// dngos grub mchog stsol mtshan dpe bzang po dang*// gnas skabs dgos 'dod stsol ba'i rin chen gyi// rgyan bzang dar zab na bza' zung gis mdzes// 'od zer bye ba'i 'phro 'dus brgyan pa'i sku// yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs dang ldan pa'i gsung*// dpag yas mkhyen brtse zung du 'jug pa'i thugs// gsang gsum yon tan kun rdzogs mgon po de'i// mtha' skor kun tu brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// yi dam lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ khyad par nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' bsgyur nas// 'gro ba'i dbul phongs sel mdzad snying rje can// dpag yas nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bcas// 'dul bya'i dpal 'byor spel ba'i dgongs pas bzhugs// phyag mchod sogs bya ba ni/ gang gi drin las lhan skyes bde ba che// skad cig nyid la 'char mdzad bla ma mchog /nam yang rnyed dka' rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs padmor phyag 'tshal lo// rnam grol lam ston brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// rnam dag chos dbyings kun khyab yi dam lha// rnam mang 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas mchog gsum la// rnam dag dad pa'i yid kyis bdag phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa yi// mchod sprin rgya mtshos rtag tu mchod par bgyi// sgo gsum bsags pa'i nyes kun so sor bshags// dus gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs// zab yangs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// bdag dang gzhan gyis dge ba ci bsags pa// mkha' mnyam 'gro bas byang chub thob phyir bsngo//

maṇḍal dbul ba ni/ zhing khams rnam dag gser gyi sa gzhi 'dir// dbus kyi ri rgyal rin chen bzhi las grub// gling bzhi gling phran rin chen ri bo dang*// dpag bsam shing dang ba mchog ma rmos lo// rgyal srid sna bdun gter gyi bum pa che// sgeg sogs lha mo mchod rdzas du mas mdzes// nyi ma zla ba gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang*// bla re ba dan rnar snyan rol mo'i tshogs// rin chen rgyan dang khang brtsegs gos bzang dang*// sna tshogs 'bru bzang bza' btung sbyar legs sogs// lha mi'i yo byad phun tshogs kyis bkang ste// nam mkha'i dkyil kun khyab cing 'khor ba'i mtha'// rnam par gnas pa de srid rgyun mi chad// gzhan yang bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po ci mchis rnams// yon gnas dam pa rje btsun chos kyi rje// brgyud par bcas dang yi dam lha tshogs dang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi// dmigs med thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bdag dang 'gro la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan gcig bsdus pa// dran pa tsam gyis phongs pa mtha' dag las// skyob mdzad dbang gi rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis// bdag gzhan snyigs ma'i dus kyi 'gro kun dang*// khyad par thos bsam sgrub brtson gang zag rnams// gnas skabs bde ba'i rten las lam bgrod phyir// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor las bzang rnams// yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod/ bla ma'i mchog sbyin mthil las ratna'i char// phab pas bdag gzhan bsam pa rdzogs byas nas// 'khor bcas 'od zhu rang nyid la thim pas// sngar gyi gdan steng bdag kyang rin 'byung skur// gyur pas 'dod rgu'i char phab mkha' mnyam gyi// sems can kun gyi re ba yongs bskangs te// 'phral dang yun gyi bde ba mchog la sbyar// kun kyang chos nyid sgyu ma'i rol pa 'o//

zhes pa'i mthar gnas lugs bskyang ngo*// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /bla ma rin 'byung sogs dang / thams cad nam mkha' mdzod sogs kyis bsngo ba bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni gzhung lugs du mar gzigs pas spyan yangs dge slong dkon mchog 'od zer gyi bzhed skong du wa gind+ras bris pa'i dge bas sems can thams cad chos dang dpal 'byor gyi phyug par gyur cig /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
